verses.1: Hallelujah! Hallelujah to the name of Jehovah! Hallelujah to the servants of Jehovah!
verses.2: They stand in the house of Jehovah, in the courtyards of our God’s house.
verses.3: Hallelujah! For the Lord is good; let us sing to His name, for He is delightful.
verses.4: For Jacob chose Israel as his people.
verses.5: For I know that Jehovah is great, and our God is greater than all other gods.
verses.6: All that Jehovah desired, He created in the heavens and on earth, throughout all ages.
verses.7: They ascend from the ends of the earth in clouds, to the place where they are created by the breath of their creator.
verses.8: He struck the livestock of Egypt, from man to animal.
verses.9: He sent messengers and threats to the people of Egypt, through Pharaoh and all his servants.
verses.10: He conquered many nations and killed their kings.
verses.11: To Siyhon, king of the Amorites; and to Og, king of the Bashan; and to all the kings of Canaan.
verses.12: And he gave their land as a inheritance to Israel, as a gift from him.
verses.13: May the name of the LORD be glorified forever; may the LORD be remembered from generation to generation.
verses.14: For Jehovah will have mercy on His people and grant forgiveness to His servants.
verses.15: The treasures of the nations are gold and silver, created by human hands.
verses.16: They shall not speak, and their eyes shall not see.
verses.17: My ears are attentive to them, but they will not listen. There is no spirit in their mouths either.
verses.18: Just as they, their works will be like all those who trust in them.
verses.19: The house of Israel blessed Jehovah. The house of Aaron also blessed Jehovah.
verses.20: The house of Leviticus blessed Jehovah. They feared Jehovah; they blessed Jehovah.
verses.21: Blessed be Jehovah, from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise Him, O YAH!
